Jordan: kicking off deploy for `redwood/serve` -> staging. tag: `v2.3.1-rc4` commit `9f7a2e3`.
Jordan: change window: now for 60m. monitoring: p50/p99 latency, error-rate. alerting enabled.
DeployBot: Deploy queued. Concurrent deploy limit (2) reached. Queue position: 4/4. Backoff policy: exponential (30s, 60s, 120s). If position >2 for >5m, will auto-deprioritize.
Sam: who else is running?
Maya: @Sam there was a canary rolling out from earlier prod->staging run.
Jordan: requesting priority bump so we don't get starved — important fix for dedupe bug in routing.
DeployBot: Priority bump requested by Jordan. Evaluating... Priority granted (manual_high). New queue position: 2/4. Estimated start: ~45s.
DeployBot: Starting deploy to staging pool `staging-1` on host node `stg-3b`. Steps:
```
- Pull image: redwood/serve:v2.3.1-rc4
- Apply config: feature_flags:{dedupe=true}
- Migrate: none
```
Alina: If error-rate > 1% over 5m, automatically rollback. Notify @oncall if degraded.
Jordan: set rollback policy: auto-if-error-rate>1% (5m); rollout speed: 10% pods every 20s.
DeployBot: Rollout progress: 10% -> 30% -> 60%.
DeployBot: Deploy completed successfully. Duration: 132s. Final status: SUCCESS. New staging pin: `v2.3.1-staging-2026-03-20`.
Maya: nice. updating release notes draft with this tag and the routing dedupe bugfix. :memo:
Sam: will prep the prod change window doc. planning prod rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC during the low-traffic window.
Jordan: thanks all. will keep an eye for regressions. :thumbsup:
